statements.sql:
SELECT email_detected_deadlines.id, email_detected_deadlines.agency_id, email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id, email_detected_deadlines.connection_id, email_detected_deadlines.message_id, email_detected_deadlines.analysis_id, email_detected_deadlines.deadline_type, email_detected_deadlines.source_phrase, email_detected_deadlines.source_fingerprint, email_detected_deadlines.source_timezone, email_detected_deadlines.due_at, email_detected_deadlines.confidence, email_detected_deadlines.is_ambiguous, email_detected_deadlines.status, email_detected_deadlines.resolution_evidence, email_detected_deadlines.created_at, email_detected_deadlines.updated_at, email_ai_analyses.id AS id_1, email_ai_analyses.agency_id AS agency_id_1, email_ai_analyses.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id_1, email_ai_analyses.connection_id AS connection_id_1, email_ai_analyses.message_id AS message_id_1, email_ai_analyses.status AS status_1, email_ai_analyses.input_hash, email_ai_analyses.prompt_schema_version, email_ai_analyses.config_version, email_ai_analyses.ai_provider, email_ai_analyses.ai_model, email_ai_analyses.intent, email_ai_analyses.priority, email_ai_analyses.summary, email_ai_analyses.confidence AS confidence_1, email_ai_analyses.needs_attention, email_ai_analyses.result_json, email_ai_analyses.context_manifest, email_ai_analyses.attempt_count, email_ai_analyses.lease_token, email_ai_analyses.lease_expires_at, email_ai_analyses.next_attempt_at, email_ai_analyses.last_error_code, email_ai_analyses.started_at, email_ai_analyses.completed_at, email_ai_analyses.duration_ms, email_ai_analyses.created_at AS created_at_1, email_ai_analyses.updated_at AS updated_at_1, email_messages.id AS id_2, email_messages.agency_id AS agency_id_2, email_messages.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id_2, email_messages.connection_id AS connection_id_2, email_messages.provider_message_id, email_messages.thread_id, email_messages.provider_history_id, email_messages.internet_message_id, email_messages.sender_address, email_messages.sender_name, email_messages.recipients_json, email_messages.subject, email_messages.body_excerpt, email_messages.label_ids, email_messages.received_at, email_messages.sent_at, email_messages.has_attachments, email_messages.relevance_status, email_messages.relevance_confidence, email_messages.evidence_json, email_messages.processing_status, email_messages.artifact_count, email_messages.processed_artifact_count, email_messages.review_count, email_messages.group_id, email_messages.ai_used, email_messages.last_error_code AS last_error_code_1, email_messages.detected_at, email_messages.processed_at, email_messages.created_at AS created_at_2, email_messages.updated_at AS updated_at_2, email_connections.id AS id_3, email_connections.agency_id AS agency_id_3, email_connections.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id_3, email_connections.provider, email_connections.provider_account_id, email_connections.email_address, email_connections.normalized_email_address, email_connections.display_name, email_connections.status AS status_2, email_connections.sync_state, email_connections.scopes, email_connections.ai_processing_enabled, email_connections.ai_enabled_at, email_connections.token_key_version, email_connections.token_expires_at, email_connections.sync_cursor, email_connections.watch_resource_id, email_connections.watch_expiration_at, email_connections.last_sync_attempt_at, email_connections.last_successful_sync_at, email_connections.last_sync_completed_at, email_connections.sync_lease_token, email_connections.sync_lease_expires_at, email_connections.sync_generation, email_connections.consecutive_failures, email_connections.next_sync_at, email_connections.last_error_code AS last_error_code_2, email_connections.last_error_message, email_connections.last_error_at, email_connections.paused_at, email_connections.disconnected_at, email_connections.created_by_user_id, email_connections.created_at AS created_at_3, email_connections.updated_at AS updated_at_3 
FROM email_detected_deadlines JOIN email_ai_analyses ON email_ai_analyses.id = email_detected_deadlines.analysis_id AND email_ai_analyses.message_id = email_detected_deadlines.message_id AND email_ai_analyses.connection_id = email_detected_deadlines.connection_id AND email_ai_analyses.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_ai_analyses.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id JOIN email_messages ON email_messages.id = email_detected_deadlines.message_id AND email_messages.connection_id = email_detected_deadlines.connection_id AND email_messages.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_messages.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id JOIN email_connections ON email_connections.id = email_detected_deadlines.connection_id AND email_connections.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_connections.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id JOIN users ON users.id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id 
WHERE email_detected_deadlines.status IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_status_3]) AND email_detected_deadlines.due_at IS NOT NULL AND email_detected_deadlines.due_at <= %(due_at_1)s AND email_ai_analyses.status IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_status_4]) AND email_connections.status IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_status_5]) AND email_connections.ai_processing_enabled IS true AND users.is_active IS true AND users.role IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_role_1]) AND (users.role = %(role_2)s OR users.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM email_ai_rollout_policies 
WHERE email_ai_rollout_policies.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_ai_rollout_policies.enabled IS false AND (email_ai_rollout_policies.scope_type = %(scope_type_1)s AND email_ai_rollout_policies.owner_user_id IS NULL AND email_ai_rollout_policies.connection_id IS NULL OR email_ai_rollout_policies.scope_type = %(scope_type_2)s AND email_ai_rollout_policies.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id AND email_ai_rollout_policies.connection_id IS NULL OR email_ai_rollout_policies.scope_type = %(scope_type_3)s AND email_ai_rollout_policies.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id AND email_ai_rollout_policies.connection_id = email_detected_deadlines.connection_id))) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM email_activity_events 
WHERE email_activity_events.changed_entity_type = %(changed_entity_type_1)s AND email_activity_events.changed_entity_id = email_detected_deadlines.id AND email_activity_events.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_activity_events.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id AND email_activity_events.event_type = CASE WHEN (email_detected_deadlines.due_at <= %(due_at_2)s) THEN %(param_1)s WHEN (email_detected_deadlines.due_at <= %(due_at_3)s) THEN %(param_2)s WHEN (email_detected_deadlines.due_at <= %(due_at_4)s) THEN %(param_3)s ELSE %(param_4)s END AND (CAST((email_activity_events.details ->> %(details_1)s) AS INTEGER) = CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM email_detected_deadlines.due_at) AS BIGINT) OR CAST((email_activity_events.details ->> %(details_1)s) AS INTEGER) IS NULL AND email_activity_events.occurred_at >= email_detected_deadlines.updated_at))) ORDER BY email_detected_deadlines.due_at ASC, email_detected_deadlines.id ASC 
 LIMIT %(param_5)s FOR UPDATE OF email_detected_deadlines SKIP LOCKED

SELECT email_detected_deadlines.id, email_detected_deadlines.agency_id, email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id, email_detected_deadlines.connection_id, email_detected_deadlines.message_id, email_detected_deadlines.analysis_id, email_detected_deadlines.deadline_type, email_detected_deadlines.source_phrase, email_detected_deadlines.source_fingerprint, email_detected_deadlines.source_timezone, email_detected_deadlines.due_at, email_detected_deadlines.confidence, email_detected_deadlines.is_ambiguous, email_detected_deadlines.status, email_detected_deadlines.resolution_evidence, email_detected_deadlines.created_at, email_detected_deadlines.updated_at, email_ai_analyses.id AS id_1, email_ai_analyses.agency_id AS agency_id_1, email_ai_analyses.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id_1, email_ai_analyses.connection_id AS connection_id_1, email_ai_analyses.message_id AS message_id_1, email_ai_analyses.status AS status_1, email_ai_analyses.input_hash, email_ai_analyses.prompt_schema_version, email_ai_analyses.config_version, email_ai_analyses.ai_provider, email_ai_analyses.ai_model, email_ai_analyses.intent, email_ai_analyses.priority, email_ai_analyses.summary, email_ai_analyses.confidence AS confidence_1, email_ai_analyses.needs_attention, email_ai_analyses.result_json, email_ai_analyses.context_manifest, email_ai_analyses.attempt_count, email_ai_analyses.lease_token, email_ai_analyses.lease_expires_at, email_ai_analyses.next_attempt_at, email_ai_analyses.last_error_code, email_ai_analyses.started_at, email_ai_analyses.completed_at, email_ai_analyses.duration_ms, email_ai_analyses.created_at AS created_at_1, email_ai_analyses.updated_at AS updated_at_1, email_messages.id AS id_2, email_messages.agency_id AS agency_id_2, email_messages.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id_2, email_messages.connection_id AS connection_id_2, email_messages.provider_message_id, email_messages.thread_id, email_messages.provider_history_id, email_messages.internet_message_id, email_messages.sender_address, email_messages.sender_name, email_messages.recipients_json, email_messages.subject, email_messages.body_excerpt, email_messages.label_ids, email_messages.received_at, email_messages.sent_at, email_messages.has_attachments, email_messages.relevance_status, email_messages.relevance_confidence, email_messages.evidence_json, email_messages.processing_status, email_messages.artifact_count, email_messages.processed_artifact_count, email_messages.review_count, email_messages.group_id, email_messages.ai_used, email_messages.last_error_code AS last_error_code_1, email_messages.detected_at, email_messages.processed_at, email_messages.created_at AS created_at_2, email_messages.updated_at AS updated_at_2, email_connections.id AS id_3, email_connections.agency_id AS agency_id_3, email_connections.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id_3, email_connections.provider, email_connections.provider_account_id, email_connections.email_address, email_connections.normalized_email_address, email_connections.display_name, email_connections.status AS status_2, email_connections.sync_state, email_connections.scopes, email_connections.ai_processing_enabled, email_connections.ai_enabled_at, email_connections.token_key_version, email_connections.token_expires_at, email_connections.sync_cursor, email_connections.watch_resource_id, email_connections.watch_expiration_at, email_connections.last_sync_attempt_at, email_connections.last_successful_sync_at, email_connections.last_sync_completed_at, email_connections.sync_lease_token, email_connections.sync_lease_expires_at, email_connections.sync_generation, email_connections.consecutive_failures, email_connections.next_sync_at, email_connections.last_error_code AS last_error_code_2, email_connections.last_error_message, email_connections.last_error_at, email_connections.paused_at, email_connections.disconnected_at, email_connections.created_by_user_id, email_connections.created_at AS created_at_3, email_connections.updated_at AS updated_at_3 
FROM email_detected_deadlines JOIN email_ai_analyses ON email_ai_analyses.id = email_detected_deadlines.analysis_id AND email_ai_analyses.message_id = email_detected_deadlines.message_id AND email_ai_analyses.connection_id = email_detected_deadlines.connection_id AND email_ai_analyses.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_ai_analyses.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id JOIN email_messages ON email_messages.id = email_detected_deadlines.message_id AND email_messages.connection_id = email_detected_deadlines.connection_id AND email_messages.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_messages.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id JOIN email_connections ON email_connections.id = email_detected_deadlines.connection_id AND email_connections.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_connections.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id JOIN users ON users.id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id 
WHERE email_detected_deadlines.status IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_status_3]) AND email_detected_deadlines.due_at IS NOT NULL AND email_detected_deadlines.due_at <= ? AND email_ai_analyses.status IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_status_4]) AND email_connections.status IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_status_5]) AND email_connections.ai_processing_enabled IS 1 AND users.is_active IS 1 AND users.role IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_role_1]) AND (users.role = ? OR users.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM email_ai_rollout_policies 
WHERE email_ai_rollout_policies.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_ai_rollout_policies.enabled IS 0 AND (email_ai_rollout_policies.scope_type = ? AND email_ai_rollout_policies.owner_user_id IS NULL AND email_ai_rollout_policies.connection_id IS NULL OR email_ai_rollout_policies.scope_type = ? AND email_ai_rollout_policies.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id AND email_ai_rollout_policies.connection_id IS NULL OR email_ai_rollout_policies.scope_type = ? AND email_ai_rollout_policies.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id AND email_ai_rollout_policies.connection_id = email_detected_deadlines.connection_id))) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM email_activity_events 
WHERE email_activity_events.changed_entity_type = ? AND email_activity_events.changed_entity_id = email_detected_deadlines.id AND email_activity_events.agency_id = email_detected_deadlines.agency_id AND email_activity_events.owner_user_id = email_detected_deadlines.owner_user_id AND email_activity_events.event_type = CASE WHEN (email_detected_deadlines.due_at <= ?) THEN ? WHEN (email_detected_deadlines.due_at <= ?) THEN ? WHEN (email_detected_deadlines.due_at <= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END AND (JSON_EXTRACT(email_activity_events.details, ?) = CAST(CAST(STRFTIME('%s', email_detected_deadlines.due_at) AS INTEGER) AS BIGINT) OR JSON_EXTRACT(email_activity_events.details, ?) IS NULL AND email_activity_events.occurred_at >= email_detected_deadlines.updated_at))) ORDER BY email_detected_deadlines.due_at ASC, email_detected_deadlines.id ASC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
